title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to get the Month Name/Text from a date (Two ways)
summary: Shows two ways to get a month name from a date in AL: Format with the Month Text date format (full or three-letter), and reading Period Name from the Date virtual table (ID 2000000007) for the month period. As an extra, the BC25 Date methods return the month number, not the name.
key_points: Format(date, 0, '<Month Text>') returns the full month name; adding a length of 3 gives the short name.
The Date virtual table has the primary key Period Type plus Period Start; getting the Month row at the start of the month returns its Period Name.
The Date table can be opened in the browser by adding the table=2000000007 URL parameter.
The BC25 Date methods (for example .Month) give the month number only, which is simplest when the number is enough.

quotes.text: The Date virtual table (ID 2000000007) in Business Central gives you easy access to days, weeks, months, quarters, and years.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability of the Date virtual table for date period operations
